fork.name: dragonpilot
fork.description: Long-running Chinese-community openpilot fork (est. 2019) with a 'Less is More' philosophy: minimal changes over a strong upstream model. Adds always-on lane keeping (ALKA), adaptive coasting/experimental/personality modes, a phone web dashboard (dashy), full multi-language UI, and support for comma 3/3X plus community O3-series hardware. Also carries a fork-added MG ZS car port.

features.name: Automated Lane Centering
features.description: Stock openpilot lateral control: steers to keep the car centered in its lane whenever openpilot is engaged.

features.name: openpilot Longitudinal Control
features.description: openpilot controls gas and brake instead of the car's stock adaptive cruise. Standard on some brands (Toyota, GM, Honda Nidec); on others it is an alpha opt-in toggle or unavailable.

features.name: Experimental Mode (end-to-end longitudinal)
features.description: The driving model directly decides speed, slowing for curves, stopped traffic and traffic lights. Requires openpilot longitudinal control on the car.

features.name: Lane Change Assist
features.description: Signal and nudge the wheel to have openpilot complete the lane change. dragonpilot adds an adjustable minimum activation speed (dp_lat_lca_speed) and an off switch.

features.name: Stop and Go
features.description: Comes to a complete stop behind traffic and resumes automatically. Depends on the car's ACC/radar hardware; some older platforms cannot auto-resume.

features.name: Driver Monitoring
features.description: Stock camera-based driver attention monitoring with escalating alerts. dragonpilot does not weaken it.

features.name: Driving Model Selector
features.description: Choose which bundled driving neural-network model to run (dp_dev_model_selected / dp_dev_model_list). Feature concept popularized by FrogPilot; dragonpilot has its own implementation.

features.name: Always-on Lane Keeping Assist (ALKA)
features.description: dragonpilot's flagship: lateral control stays active when ACC Main is on even with cruise disengaged, toggled by the ACC Main/LKAS button; vehicle must be moving. Opt-in toggle, gated in panda safety per brand (Toyota/Lexus, Honda, Hyundai/Kia/Genesis, VW group, Subaru, Mazda, Nissan, Ford, MG). Pioneered by dragonpilot in v0.6.2 (2019).

features.name: Dashy Web Dashboard
features.description: Phone-browser dashboard served from the device (always-on serverd plus onroad dashyd) for live status and settings without the comma cloud. Opt-in toggle.

features.name: Adaptive Coasting Mode
features.description: Reduces braking to allow smoother coasting when appropriate. Opt-in toggle; only shown/active when the car runs openpilot longitudinal control.

features.name: Adaptive Experimental Mode
features.description: Automatically switches between ACC and Blended/Experimental longitudinal based on driving context. Opt-in; requires openpilot longitudinal control.

features.name: Adaptive Personality Mode
features.description: Automatically switches driving personality to Aggressive below ~30 km/h and restores your chosen personality above 40 km/h. Opt-in; requires openpilot longitudinal control.

features.name: Auto Lane Change (timer)
features.description: After signaling, openpilot starts the lane change by itself after a configurable delay (dp_lat_lca_auto_sec) — no steering nudge needed. Off by default.

features.name: Road Edge Detection
features.description: Blocks lane change assist toward a detected road edge, surfacing a 'Car Detected in Blindspot' style warning. Opt-in toggle.

features.name: Lane Position Offset
features.description: Fine-tune where the car sits in the lane in centimeters (positive = left, negative = right).

features.name: Multi-language UI
features.description: Full Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and English interface with live language switching; dragonpilot shipped multi-language UI before upstream openpilot.

features.name: Display Mode & HUD Hiding
features.description: Control when the screen is on/off (tied to ACC Main or engagement) and optionally hide speed/MAX/icons above a set speed to prevent screen burn-in.

features.name: Lead / Radar Stats Overlay
features.description: On-screen statistics for the lead car and/or radar tracking points; radar option only works on some vehicles.

features.name: Rainbow Driving Path
features.description: Tesla-style rainbow driving path rendering. Pure fun toggle ('Why not?').

features.name: External Radar Support
features.description: Opt-in support for an aftermarket external radar (eFiniLan openpilot-ext-radar-addon) to provide lead data on cars without usable radar.

features.name: Stock ACC Longitudinal Toggle
features.description: Per-brand toggles (Toyota/Lexus, Honda Nidec) to hand gas/brake back to the car's built-in ACC while openpilot keeps steering.

features.name: Device Utilities
features.description: Bundle of dp device toggles: auto shutdown timer, tethering on boot, disable comma-connect, delayed logging, audible alert modes, engagement beep, and the opview live camera viewer.

features.name: comma 3 & O3-series Hardware Support
features.description: Runs on comma 3 and 3X plus community O3 / O3L / O3XL hardware; dragonpilot remained the fork supporting comma 3 after comma dropped it in 0.10.0.

features.name: Stop-and-Go Restore (TSS1 / VAG A0)
features.description: Community-derived toggles that restore auto-resume from a stop on Toyota TSS1 vehicles and VAG A0-platform cars (Polo, Fabia, Kamiq, Scala, T-Cross). Off by default.

features.name: VW EPS Lockout Avoidance
features.description: Scales steering torque down at low speeds on VW-group cars to avoid the EPS locking out openpilot steering. Opt-in toggle.

features.name: Toyota Auto Door Lock/Unlock
features.description: Auto-locks doors above 20 km/h and unlocks when shifting to Park on Toyota/Lexus. Community-lineage convenience feature, opt-in.
